adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path sets `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists it via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) returns the *Zod safeParse result object* (`{ success, data, ... }`), not the parsed credential data itself. Other usages in the diff treat the return as a safeParse result and persist `...tokenResponse.data` (e.g., Salesforce spreads `accessTokenParsed.data` into the stored key). Therefore Google Calendar will store `{success, data}` as the credential key, which will not match `googleCredentialSchema` when later parsing `credential.key` as the actual credential payload.
